stemMd: Which expression is equal to (x + y)² − (x − y)² for all real x and y?
explanationMd: Expand both squares: x² + 2xy + y² minus x² − 2xy + y². The pure square terms cancel and the cross terms add to 4xy. Careful distribution of the subtraction sign is essential.

distractorRationale.d: This counts only half of the surviving cross terms.
distractorRationale.b: Those square terms cancel in the subtraction.
distractorRationale.e: The two squares are not generally equal.
distractorRationale.a: This incorrectly squares the cross product.
